maxDropoff.title: Maximum Drop-off Point Found
maxDropoff.body: The biggest drop-off occurs at the "{{step}}" step. Conversion rate is {{rate}}%, with {{dropOff}} users dropping off at this step.
maxDropoff.rec1: Simplify the user experience at this step
maxDropoff.rec2: Add a progress indicator to encourage completion

platformGap.title: Platform Performance Gap Found
platformGap.body: {{worst}} has a {{gap}}%p lower conversion rate than {{best}}.
platformGap.rec1: Investigate bugs or UX issues per platform
platformGap.rec2: Test the flow on the underperforming platform

channelGap.title: Large Channel Performance Variance Found
channelGap.rec2: Analyze user quality differences across channels
channelGap.rec3: Review landing page experience per channel

bestSegment.title: Best Performing Segment
bestSegment.body: {{name}} shows strong performance with a {{rate}}% conversion rate.
bestSegment.rec1: Analyze what makes this segment successful
bestSegment.rec3: Increase investment in similar audience profiles

lowD1.title: Low D1 Retention Warning
lowD1.body: D1 retention is only {{rate}}%, which is below the healthy threshold of 25%.
lowD1.rec1: Improve onboarding to quickly demonstrate value
lowD1.rec3: Implement quick wins or achievements in the first session

steepestDrop.title: Steepest Retention Drop Identified
steepestDrop.body: The steepest retention drop ({{drop}}%p) occurs between Day {{dayFrom}} and Day {{dayTo}}.
steepestDrop.rec1: Start an engagement campaign on Day {{dayFrom}}
steepestDrop.rec2: Introduce new content or features at this point

trialConversion.title: Trial → Subscription Conversion Needs Improvement
trialConversion.body: Only {{rate}}% of trial users convert to paid subscriptions (n={{count}}).
trialConversion.rec1: Encourage core feature usage during trial
trialConversion.rec2: Offer reminders and benefits before trial ends
trialConversion.rec3: Improve onboarding flow for faster value delivery

slowConversion.title: Subscription Decision Delay
slowConversion.body: Median time from trial start to subscription is {{days}} days.
slowConversion.rec1: Test shorter trial periods (7 days vs 14 days)
slowConversion.rec3: Add value proof points during trial

paymentFailure.title: High Payment Failure Rate
paymentFailure.rec3: Implement immediate retry logic on payment failure

highChurn.title: High Paid Subscription Churn Rate
highChurn.body: {{rate}}% of paid users have churned ({{count}} users).
highChurn.rec1: Identify and intervene with at-risk users
highChurn.rec2: Analyze churn reasons and respond accordingly
highChurn.rec3: Offer loyalty programs or long-term discounts

cancelReason.title: Top Cancellation Reason: {{reason}}
cancelReason.body: {{share}}% of churned users cited "{{reason}}" as their reason.
cancelReason.rec1: Conduct in-depth interviews on cancellation reasons

lowD7Paid.title: Low D7 Paid Subscription Retention
lowD7Paid.body: 7-day retention after subscription is {{rate}}%, below the 70% target.
lowD7Paid.rec2: Set first-week usage goals and guidance

toast.requiredColumnsDesc: Timestamp, User ID, and Event Name columns are required.
toast.processCompleteDesc: Navigate to other pages to analyze.
